description: JSON parameter wire form: the generated JSON type is written by exec and batch and read back, and the stored document is described with the engine's own functions, compared with the same text as a literal and found by the document as a parameter; the document holds spacing, key order, a trailing zero, HTML characters and two- and four-byte UTF-8. Value returns the text, so every row is stored as text, read back byte for byte, and found both ways. The same golden covers modernc.org/sqlite and mattn/go-sqlite3 through sqlite_cgo.
